title: ControlDomainDiagnosticV1.0.1
description: WS2-owned route-specific diagnostic payload. Exact domain_code and cause_code are independent. Unknown future cause_code values that satisfy syntax are preserved verbatim and remain UNKNOWN/UNRESOLVED; no auth/retry/terminal inference.

cause_code.description: Exact case-sensitive source cause string. Preserve unrecognized future values verbatim; never infer authentication, retryability, terminality or success.
